//: The JVM parity runner's burn-down books (card A-22, docs/plans/android-assessment.md §5.4; the rules are in player/parity/jvm-pending.js). families: a whole fixture family the JVM does not run yet -> the Android card that ports it; cases: one case owed inside a family the JVM does run -> its card. The JVM runner (foray-engine-core-jvm ParitySuite, android-build.yml) fails when a case not owed fails, when an owed case passes (stale: delete the entry), and when a manifest id is neither run nor owed. record.mjs --jvm-card hands a case new or changed in a family the JVM runs, or a new family, to a card. jsOnly families are never owed. A family unported.json will record into may be owed ahead of its fixtures.
